name: cognition
description: Your mind is the architect. Work through design, data flow, and failure modes with Codex before any code gets written.

interface.shortDescription: Reason through the design; Codex writes what you decided
interface.longDescription: Cognition keeps the reasoning in your hands. Codex waits for your approach, pushes back on weak spots, and explains anything unfamiliar along the way. Once you've settled on a design and said so, it implements exactly that and walks you through the result.
